findings.finding: After manager_add_filter, source unreferences store and removes its compiled-filter directory before constructing/loading the view. No verified guarantee establishes backing-file/FD lifetime through later web-process use.
findings.action: Conservatively retain owned store/directory until all referencing views/managers/filter objects are retired; retain/quarantine on unretired async completion. Register ownership on allocation, including store creation failure, and avoid premature path deletion.

findings.finding: compileFilter correctly retains callback/result/cancellable when cancellation does not produce an observed completion, avoiding a guessed free. Unretired store/path must remain reachable and cleanup unconfirmed.
findings.action: Preserve quarantine semantics through repair; never free callbacks merely because250ms drain elapsed. Account for all allocation/exception paths and callback main-context ownership.

findings.finding: Current EngineResult pass is derived from a normal loop exit and local cleanup, without observing successful document loads. uiShouldStop can end the loop at deadline while all views stayed blank or failed.
findings.action: Track actual exact-URI load progress and load-failed/web-process-terminated events. FINISHED alone is insufficient because GIR states it also follows failed loads. Do not infer Elm execution or CSP enforcement from load completion.

findings.finding: Successful GObject unrefs/signal disconnections do not establish that engine helper processes retired. There is no observed helper-process shutdown receipt in this source.
findings.action: Make local-ref cleanup and whole-engine/helper retirement scopes explicit. Keep whole-host/engine retirement unconfirmed where absent; do not set a whole-host pass merely from local cleanup or process-loop exit. Root-owned outer process custody must be independently observed.

findings.finding: g_cancellable_cancel and policy use/ignore are unsafe imports despite potentially dispatching native callbacks/signals; source comments promise safe calls for reentrant operations.
findings.action: Use safe FFI for callback-capable operations; preserve Haskell callback lifetime until exact disconnect/observed completion.

findings.finding: GObject constructor property names are runtime strings, not checked by GHC. Requested ephemeral session/manager/context must actually be installed in the resulting view.
findings.action: Pinned GTK6 headers/GIR provide get_network_session/get_user_content_manager/get_context and construct-only properties. Verify pointer identity/actual ephemeral session before load; fail closed on mismatch.

findings.finding: Navigation/response policy defaults deny, rejects redirects/nonapproved URI/MIME/Content-Disposition, but absence of observed all-download denial cannot be replaced by MIME/header inference.
findings.action: Pinned GIR confirms NetworkSession.download-started(session,download,userdata)->void; attach a retained safe cancellation callback using webkit_download_cancel. Disconnect before freeing callback/session; do not claim actual denial until engine evidence.

Existing view/window/signal reference cleanup order keeps the view alive until signal disconnection; callback pointer is freed after exact handler disconnection. Native signal-dispatching constructors/load/destroy/main-loop APIs generally use safe FFI.
Entry point enters private network before config/IO workers/engine. Original D is read through UiEndpoints; source does not renew admission or call an alternate renderer/device path.
